note: Samuel R. McKelvie NF, SE corner, in the shade of ponderosa pines planted in the early 1900s; ~18 mi south of Nenzel on State Spur 16F. Hand water pump (not potable), picnic tables, fire rings; 8-stall horse corral and the 1-mi Blue Jay nature loop. Pay at the envelope box near the entrance within 30 minutes of picking a site. The loop roads are unpaved Sandhills dirt. --Claude
